words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.ex: The temple was built in AD 300.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙建于公元300年。
words.en: An ad is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.ex: He twisted his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: The joint between the foot and the leg, in which movement occurs in two planes.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.ex: Although it was raining, he went outside.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite the fact that; even though.

words.ex: The child drew a picture of an angel with wings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅有翅膀的天使的画。
words.en: An angel is a spiritual being believed to act as a messenger or servant of God, conventionally represented in human form with wings and a long robe.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: The forest has abundant water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林水源和树木都很丰富。
words.en: If something is abundant, there is a lot of it or it is very common.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr: n. 广告（advertisement 的复数形式）
words.ex: He sees many ads on his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他在手机上看到很多广告。
words.en: Ads are messages or announcements intended to promote a product, service, or event, typically in a public medium such as television, radio, or the internet.

words.ex: An ant is carrying a leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚂蚁正在搬一片叶子。
words.en: A small insect, often with a sting, that lives in a complex social colony with one or more breeding queens. It is wingless except for fertile adults, which form large mating swarms, and is proverbial for its industriousness.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.ex: They aren't coming to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他们不来参加派对了。
words.en: Aren't is the usual spoken form of 'are not'.

words.ex: He asked for assistance with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他请求帮助做作业。
words.en: The act of helping or supporting someone or something.

words.ex: The teacher has an assistant to help with grading.
words.ex_cn: 老师有一个助理帮忙批改作业。
words.en: An assistant is a person who helps in particular work or who is under the authority of another person.

words.ex: He ate an apple for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个苹果。
words.en: the past tense of eat, which means to consume food

words.ex: He has eight apples in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他包里有八个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and four; one more than seven, or two less than ten; 8.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: n. 屁股，肛门，性交; 驴( ass的名词复数 ); 傻瓜; 臀部
words.ex: He fell on his asses while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时摔在了屁股上。
words.en: Asses is the plural form of ass, which refers to a donkey or a foolish person.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: He showed gratitude for the help.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对帮助的感激。
words.en: Gratitude is the feeling of being thankful and appreciative.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.tr:
v. 沐浴；用水洗；沉浸
n. 游泳
words.ex: He bathes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上洗澡。
words.en: To bathe means to wash oneself or someone else, especially in a bath or the sea, or to spend time in water for pleasure.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.ex: The passengers are aboard the plane.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在飞机上。
words.en: On or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他去国外学医。
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.tr:
n. 带扣；皮带扣
v. （使）搭扣扣住
words.ex: The belt has a shiny buckle.
words.ex_cn: 这条皮带有一个闪亮的带扣。
words.en: A buckle is a piece of metal or plastic attached to one end of a belt or strap, which is used to fasten it. As a verb, to buckle means to fasten something with a buckle or to bend or collapse under pressure.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.ex: She washed the bed sheet yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天洗了床单。
words.en: A bed sheet is a large piece of cloth used to cover a mattress, often used in pairs with one sheet below the sleeper and one sheet above.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: He picked a red berry from the bush.
words.ex_cn: 他从灌木丛中摘了一颗红色浆果。
words.en: A berry is a small, round fruit that grows on a bush or a tree. Some berries are edible and can be eaten raw or used in cooking.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些布来做裙子。
words.en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, or other threads. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.tr: n. 香奈儿（法国时尚品牌）
words.ex: She bought a bag from Chanel.
words.ex_cn: 她从香奈儿买了一个包。
words.en: Chanel is a French luxury fashion house founded by Coco Chanel, known for its haute couture, ready-to-wear, handbags, perfumes, and other luxury goods.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.ex: Kate is reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 凯特正在读书。
words.en: A female given name, often a short form of Katherine.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了鸡肉。
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.ex: He listened to his conscience and told the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他听从了良心，说出了真相。
words.en: Your conscience is the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is right or wrong.

words.ex: He values conciseness in his writing.
words.ex_cn: 他重视写作的简洁性。
words.en: Conciseness refers to the quality of being concise, which means expressing what needs to be said without unnecessary words.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价50分。
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.tr: v. 发送；送；寄；“send”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He sent a message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友发了一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.tr:
adj. 理想的；
n. 理想；典范；
words.ex: This is the ideal place to relax.
words.ex_cn: 这是放松的理想地方。
words.en: An ideal is a principle or value that one actively pursues as a goal, often in the context of ethics or morality.

words.ex: He wore a decent shirt to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件像样的衬衫去面试。
words.en: Decent is used to describe something which is considered to be of an acceptable standard or quality.

words.ex: The plane began its descent at 10,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在一万英尺高度开始下降。
words.en: The act of moving or falling downward.

words.ex: The sun descends behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在山后落下。
words.en: If you descend or if you descend a staircase, you move downwards from a higher to a lower level.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: The birds sing at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.

words.ex: The heavy rain drowned the small village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小村庄。
words.en: To die by being underwater too long and unable to breathe, or to kill someone in this way.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr: v. 飞翔；飞行；“fly”的过去式；
words.ex: The bird flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿飞过了树。
words.en: Flew is the past tense of fly, which means to move through the air using wings.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子饿了，哭着要吃的。
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.tr: n. （Hungary）匈牙利；（美、希、加、印）亨加尔丽（人名）
words.ex: He is from Hungary.
words.ex_cn: 他来自匈牙利。
words.en: A country in Central Europe; the correct spelling is 'Hungary'.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: Children tend to be more active in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子往往在早上更活跃。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一都有数学课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.ex: He lost his keys yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天丢了钥匙。
words.en: If you lose something, you no longer have it or you cannot find it.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.ex: He drinks a latte every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯拿铁。
words.en: A latte is a type of coffee made with espresso and steamed milk.

words.ex: He walked alone in the lone park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自走在空无一人的公园里。
words.en: If you talk about a lone person or thing, you mean that they are alone.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: He will return next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月回来。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: The mouse ran under the table.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠跑到了桌子下面。
words.en: A mouse is a small animal with a long tail, which is found in houses and fields and is often kept as a pet. In computing, a mouse is a small device that you move across a surface in order to move a cursor on your computer screen.

words.ex: The children are merry on Christmas day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节那天很开心。
words.en: If you describe someone's character or behavior as merry, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.ex: They will marry next summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在明年夏天结婚。
words.en: To marry someone means to become their husband or wife in a legal or religious ceremony.

words.ex: Mary likes to walk her dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 玛丽每天早上都喜欢遛狗。
words.en: A female given name, often a short form of Mary or Marie.

words.ex: He likes maths because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: the science of numbers, quantities, and shapes and the relationships between them

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在三月。
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: The motion of the ball is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 球的运动非常快。
words.en: The action or process of moving or being moved.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: She puts lotion on her hands after washing them.
words.ex_cn: 她洗手后在手上涂乳液。
words.en: A lotion is a liquid that you use to clean, improve, or protect your skin or hair.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.ex: Ms. Li teaches English at our school.
words.ex_cn: 李老师在我们学校教英语。
words.en: a title used before the name of a woman regardless of her marital status

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: The price of bread is too high.
words.ex_cn: 面包的价格太高了。
words.en: The amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.ex: The sky turned pale blue at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时，天空变成了淡蓝色。
words.en: Something that is pale is not strong or bright in color.

words.ex: It is quite cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天很冷。
words.en: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree; fairly.

words.ex: The child is quiet during nap time.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在午睡时很安静。
words.en: Making little or no noise; free from disturbance or tumult; tranquil; calm.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.ex: Robert likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 罗伯特喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name, of Germanic origin meaning 'bright fame'.

words.ex: Roberts is a teacher at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 罗伯茨是当地学校的一名老师。
words.en: A common English surname, derived from the given name Robert, meaning 'bright fame'.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；真正的；
words.ex: This is a real diamond, not fake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是假的。
words.en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐成一排。
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.ex: He didn't refer to the book during the talk.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中没有提到那本书。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them. If you refer to someone or something as a particular thing, you use a particular word, expression, or name to mention or describe them.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: He will defer his trip until next month.
words.ex_cn: 他将把旅行推迟到下个月。
words.en: If you defer an event or action, you arrange for it to happen at a later date, rather than immediately or at the previously planned time.

words.ex: The university conferred an honorary degree on him.
words.ex_cn: 大学授予他一个荣誉学位。
words.en: To confer something such as a degree or an honor on someone means to give it to them in a formal way. To confer with someone means to discuss something with them in order to make a decision.

words.ex: He inferred that she was tired from her yawns.
words.ex_cn: 他从她的哈欠推断出她很累。
words.en: If you infer that something is the case, you decide that it is true on the basis of information that you already have.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.ex: The ad induced him to buy the product.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告诱使他购买了该产品。
words.en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: He has six apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他桌子上有六个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and two; one more than five, or four less than ten; 6.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: He plays the sax at night clubs.
words.ex_cn: 他在夜总会吹萨克斯。
words.en: A sax is a musical instrument that you play by blowing into it and pressing keys to produce different notes.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: The snake crawled slowly through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蛇在草丛中缓慢地爬行。
words.en: A snake is a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.tr: n. 调查；勘测；“survey”的复数； v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did surveys about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: Surveys are a method of gathering information from a sample of people, traditionally with the intention of generalizing the results to a larger population.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.tr:
adj. 甜的；悦人的；
n. 糖果；
words.ex: The cake is sweet and delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕又甜又美味。
words.en: Sweet is used to describe something that tastes of sugar or is pleasant in a way that is reminiscent of sugar. It can also describe something that is pleasing to the senses other than taste, such as a sound or smell, or something that is kind and gentle.

words.ex: He sweats heavily after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后大量出汗。
words.en: Sweat is the salty liquid that comes out through the skin when you are hot, ill, or afraid.

words.ex: He wears a warm sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件暖和的毛衣。
words.en: A sweater is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. It is usually made of wool or cotton and has long sleeves.

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr:
v. 叹息；叹气
n. 叹息；叹气
words.ex: He sighed when he saw the messy room.
words.ex_cn: 他看到凌乱的房间时叹了口气。
words.en: To sigh is to let out a deep breath slowly and audibly, often as a sign of sadness, tiredness, or relief.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.ex: He poured sauce on his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他把酱汁倒在意大利面上。
words.en: A sauce is a thick liquid which is served with other food.

words.ex: The game simulates real traffic conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏模拟了真实的交通状况。
words.en: To simulate is to create a model or representation of a situation, process, or system for the purpose of study, analysis, or training. It involves imitating the conditions of a real event or environment to understand its effects or to practice responses to it.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.tr: vt. 使负重担（tax的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: The hard work taxed him greatly.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作让他感到压力巨大。
words.en: Subject to or burdened with a tax or charge; overworked or weary.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: Blue jeans are in vogue this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.tr:
adv. 非常；很；
adj. 恰好是；正是；
words.ex: He is very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.ex: Venus is the brightest planet in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 金星是夜空中最亮的行星。
words.en: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, orbiting it every 224.7 Earth days. It is named after the Roman goddess of love and beauty.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.tr:
adj. 值得的；有…价值；
n. 价值；
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天步行去学校。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.
